title: Organ & Body Donations: Last Week Tonight with John Oliver (HBO)
summary: A Last Week Tonight segment on organ and body donation, covering where donations actually go, how donated bodies are used and sold, and problems in organ transplant programs.
why: HN cites it in threads about donated bodies and organ transplant failures as a critical look at opaque systems.

quote.text: John Oliver had a pretty good episode about hospitals, organ donation organisations and even non-profits
